title: 女孩和月亮的夜晚對話
logline: 一個女孩在夜晚和月亮溫柔對話，感受星空的神奇和寧靜。

characters.name: 女孩
characters.appearance: young girl, curly brown hair, pink pajamas, red slippers, small necklace

panels.scene: 夜晚，女孩站在自家窗邊凝望天空。
panels.image_prompt: girl standing by window looking up, night sky visible outside, warm indoor light

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: 女孩抬頭看著深藍色的夜空。

panels.scene: 女孩看到明亮的月亮，開始對它說話。
panels.image_prompt: girl speaking softly to bright full moon outside window, gentle expression

panels.scene: 月光灑進屋內，女孩伸手試圖摸摸月光。
panels.image_prompt: girl's hand reaching out to soft glowing moonlight on windowsill

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: 月光溫柔地灑在女孩手上。

panels.scene: 女孩和月亮像朋友般聊天，臉上帶著開心微笑。
panels.image_prompt: girl smiling joyfully, looking up to moon with warm feelings

panels.scene: 月光照亮女孩整個房間，她感到安心與幸福。
panels.image_prompt: girl sitting happily under moonlight inside cozy room, peaceful atmosphere

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: 女孩感受到月亮的溫暖陪伴。

panels.scene: 女孩安心地躺回床上，望著窗外月亮入睡。
panels.image_prompt: girl lying peacefully in bed, eyes closed, moon visible through window

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: 女孩帶著微笑進入夢鄉。
